verdict.rationale: An API platform with a self-hostable backend could plausibly ship official SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence documents a CLI, an MCP server and request code-snippet generation, but no official client SDKs. Snippet generation is an adjacent feature that produces code for the user's own requests; it is not an SDK for building against Hoppscotch, and the CLI and MCP server are separate stories.
